cases.actual: Hard reload paused exact GET /api/nodes while same target displayed 5 skeletons; continued GET 200 returned 6 API items and 6 UI rows. Exact request interception produced five real net::ERR_FAILED loading failures, then actual alert + Retry button. Fetch/cache interception was removed before clicking Retry; exact GET returned 200 and UI/API both showed 6 rows, alert cleared. A separate authenticated read-only GET confirmed 6 items, so true EmptyState remains unobserved.
